from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """The liability figure reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written, e.g. 'Total Current Liabilities' or 'Total Liabilities'")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The liability amount as reported (raw number, not converted)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this reporting period")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g. 'Form 10-Q'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt with the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
